message:
Now let me understand the flow better. When `NewCodePage` is called, `lineIndex` is not initialized. Then when the page is used and eventually released via `ReleaseCodePageNoTrack`, it's pushed to `pagesOpen` or `pagesFull`. When later `RemoveCodePageOfCapacity` is called on `pagesOpen`, it calls `NumFreeLines` which reads `lineIndex`.

But actually, let me look at how the first page is acquired and used. Let me look at `m3_LoadModule` and how compilation starts:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "AcquireCodePage\|NewCodePage\|lineIndex" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/wasm3/source/m3_compile.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
